answer: Attention Decay Ledger. Each identity must continuously answer randomized micro-challenges; response latency is logged and an echo of prior answers reduces credit. Credit decays unless sustained, so idle accounts fall below the access threshold. A sybil must fund parallel attention streams across every fake identity, and a plume of identical timing patterns flags coordinated farms for throttling. Honest users maintain one steady terrace of activity; attackers pay the full opportunity cost of real-time attention per identity, which scales linearly and cannot be shared.
